free_tier.stated: None: the domain no longer hosts the indexer. A request for https://simplynzbs.com/ answers a redirect to http://ww80.simplynzbs.com/?subid1=<uuid> - the shape of a lapsed domain on a parking service - and that host name no longer resolves on 2026-11-03. A review states the service is 'no longer operational as of 2024-2025'. The last published free tier was invite-gated.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an NZB pointer file

retention.stated: last claimed 'up to 2,145 days retention' while operating; no longer served

egress.terms: none: every request is answered by a redirect to a parking host that does not respond

interface_detail: Was Newznab-compatible ('The SimplyNZBs API is compatible with ...' in its own invite page). Today the host redirects to a parking subdomain and /api?t=caps is answered by the same non-API redirect.
tooling: Nothing to configure: Prowlarr and NZBHydra2 cannot reach an indexer that does not answer.

limits.value: 10 API hits and 5 NZB downloads per day (historical, invite-gated)

binding_note: The service is gone, so the binding constraint is the one that killed it: no reachable write path at all.

identity_cost.detail: Was invite-only: 'weekly 50 users get 10 invites each' plus a paid bypass. Today no registration path answers.

reliability_note: Dead: the name redirects to a parking host that no longer resolves; a rendered read of the domain through a pinned provider ends on a human-verification page that offers a software installer download. A client that still has it configured follows the redirect and gets no result, not an auth error.
confidence_note: The redirect to a parking subdomain was observed today, and that is strong evidence of a lapsed domain. The rung stays reported because the authoritative statement of death ('no longer operational as of 2024-2025') is third-party; the redirect alone does not date it.

evidence.proved: the request redirects to http://ww80.simplynzbs.com/?subid1=ba516fd4-ce86-11f1-9da0-c6ff21bde0c4, a parking host, which then fails with Cloudflare 520 'origin returned an unknown or empty response'
no Newznab document: the same redirect applies, so no API is served

extras.death_signal: domain redirects (HTTP 302) to a parking host, ww80.simplynzbs.com, whose name no longer resolves
extras.probe_sequence: an earlier request returned a 504; the later one showed the redirect. Both were kept rather than the first one reported as the truth.

notes: The verdict changed while the record was being written: the first two probes returned a 504, which reads as 'down', and a later probe returned 200 on the first hop, which looked like 'up'. Reading the redirect target settled it - the 200 was a redirect to a parking service. A session that stopped at the first probe would have written a different and wrong reason.
